in_marathi.name: Bhairavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Music
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhairavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhairavi is a Sanskrit word derived from Bhairava, the name of a Hindu deity. In Hindu mythology, Bhairavi is considered to be the goddess of music and the consort of Lord Shiva. She is believed to bestow the power of music upon her devotees, helping them to find inner peace and harmony.
